replies.author: goldenwalrus909
replies.body:
This looks really good and fun to play on! :D
Personally, I think this would play really well on TDM, but CTM is good, too :3
The only suggestions I could make are to make the grass part between the (almost) circle a little bigger and to make the island in the center stretch horizontally all the way until it become aligned with the corners of the castle boundary. Very good!
+1
